title: Aqua Blue | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home* Private Beach Access just steps away* Stunning Gulf Views from 2nd and 3rd Floors* 4 Bikes Included!* Outdoor Grilling and Lounge Area* Next to the Sparkling Community Pool* Back Patio with Outside Shower
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home* Private Beach Access just steps away* Stunning Gulf Views from 2nd and 3rd Floors* 4 Bikes Included!* Outdoor Grilling and Lounge Area* Next to the Sparkling Community Pool* Back Patio with Outside Shower* Snorkel the Grouper Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Only 1 mile to Rosemary Beach* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* Welcome to your home away from home for years to come! Aqua Blue is a 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath luxury home just off scenic Hwy 30A in Inlet Beach. Built in 2015, this gorgeous home features upscale décor and high-end finishes, including limestone counters, rough sawn hardwood floors throughout, plus stunning Gulf Views from the 2nd and 3rd floors. Enjoy games around the table or relax in one of the two comfortable living areas. The king master suite boasts wall to wall views towards the Gulf, along with a sitting area and private bathroom. Additionally, there are king and queen guest rooms, a full over full bunk room, and a living room sleeper sofa, sleeping up to 12 guests comfortably. With private beach access less than 200ft away and a community pool steps from your door, you’ll have everything you need for the perfect beach vacation at Aqua Blue!The Cottages at Inlet Beach is a gated Gulf-side community of only 11 luxury homes in a private neighborhood setting. Nestled on the east end of 30A near Rosemary Beach, this exclusive community is a short bike ride from the attractions at Rosemary and the new 30Avenue development. With private beach access, a sparkling community pool, and world-class dining and shopping nearby, the Cottages at Inlet Beach is the perfect place to relax and unwind!The Bed Setup:2nd Floor Master Bedroom: King Bed w/ ensuite Guest Bedroom: King Bed w/ ensuite 3rd Floor Guest Bedroom: Full over Full Bunk BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedLiving Room: Sofa SleeperArea Attractions: Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
